entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: D5 or Yaroslavsko-Paveletsky Diameter is the fifth line of the Moscow Central Diameters which will open in 2028 or later. The line may have 39 stations with the main route between Pushkino and Domodedovo stations and a branch route between Mytishchi and Shchyolkovo stations.
